Implement an accepted repeatable-work candidate as the smallest durable instruction, script, skill, hook, automation, or plugin proposal. Use only when explicitly invoked with $productize-repeatable-work and an accepted stable candidate ID; do not discover or broaden scope.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link productize-repeatable-work
```

## Examples

### Implement an accepted candidate

**Prompt**

> Use $productize-repeatable-work to implement accepted candidate R1 exactly as recorded in this conversation.

**Expected outcome**

One narrow instruction, script, skill, hook, automation, or plugin change with relevant validation and no rediscovery.

### Reject a broader carrier

**Prompt**

> Use $productize-repeatable-work for R2, but stop if the accepted target no longer fits the current repository state.

**Expected outcome**

Either a verified minimal artifact or a revised proposal explaining why the recorded target would now broaden scope.
